concerns.text: Task T001 [P] creates a quick‑start guide that runs `fetch_data.py`, `train.py`, and `evaluate.py`. Those scripts are produced by tasks T002‑T005, which are scheduled *after* T001. This makes T001 a consumer before its producers, violating the foundational‑tasks‑first ordering rule (FR‑010).

Task T001 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it depends on the existence of scripts generated in later tasks (T002‑T005). Because it cannot safely run in parallel with those producer tasks, the `[P]` tag is inaccurate.
